evidence: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA
no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) system — patient registration subsystem (患者登録 P02 main program)
purpose.summary: ORCGP02 is the main controller program for the patient registration screen group (P02) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen navigation (PUTG/CLICKED events), patient master data entry/update, insurance combination management, hospitalization records, and CLAIM processing via shell script invocation. It coordinates numerous subprograms and copybooks covering patient info, insurance, appointments, receipts, and billing.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (81 copybooks) for JMA ORCA framework
CALL-heavy architecture (111 CALLs) to subprograms for DB access and screen editing
MCP (Message Control Program) event-driven screen framework (MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT EVALUATE)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA/SCRAREA — JMA ORCA standard linkage pattern
Shell script invocation for CLAIM processing (scripts/claim/HL01.sh)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
No COMP-3 usage despite financial/medical domain
Extensive SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern for screen state management
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese, appearing garbled. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 4459 lines / 186KB. Program type classified as online-cics by analogy — JMA ORCA uses its own MCP event-driven framework (not CICS) but the pattern is equivalent to an online transaction program. The program_type 'online-cics' is the closest available enum value.
